guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice_socket is the dominant outlier (3 -> 7.82, +160.7%, z=+32.13), while no other series exceeds |z|=2 and currencyservice_mem (z=+1.91) is only a minor shift. The slowest traces all pass through currencyservice, though the traces show error spans only in frontendservice and the logs contain no warnings or errors, so the evidence is indirect.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect currencyservice open connections and socket usage, then restart or roll the currencyservice pod only if the leaked or stuck connections are confirmed. Check for a connection leak in its client or server handling.
